caseNameFull: Ferguson, Attorney General of Kansas v. Skrupa, doing business as Credit Advisors
attorneys: Wilkie Bushby and Joseph Schreiber on the motion.

opinions.text: Appeal from the United States District Court for the District of Kansas. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 371 U. S. 807.) The motion of National Better Business Bureau, Inc., for leave to file a brief, as .amicus curiae, is granted.
